title: QualityForge completeness-criteria configuration
description: Versioned configuration of SOAP note completeness criteria (spec section 8.2). The criteria file is machine-readable acceptance criteria: the evaluator and every downstream agent consume it directly, so it can change without rewriting the evaluator. Evidence-span semantics (review R3) and the section-identification strategy (review R5) are pinned here and versioned with the criteria.

criteria_version.description: Semantic version of the criteria set. Bumped on any criteria or detection-logic change (spec section 8.2: criteria live in a versioned configuration file).

name.description: Stable name of the criteria set, e.g. soap-note-completeness.

description.description: Human-readable scope statement. Criteria are documented documentation-completeness rules, not clinical judgments (spec section 8.2).

evidence_span_semantics.description: Pinned per review R3 so every downstream agent inherits one definition: zero-based character offsets into the exact note_text string from the request, end-exclusive, no whitespace or unicode normalization.

offset_base.description: Offsets count characters, not tokens or bytes.

index_origin.description: The first character of note_text is at offset 0.

end_exclusive.description: `end` is exclusive: the span covers note_text[start:end].

reference_text.description: Offsets index the exact note_text string from the request, never a normalized copy.

normalization.description: No whitespace or unicode normalization before indexing.

section_detection.description: Section-identification strategy, versioned with this file per review R5: changing detection logic is a criteria-version change, not an evaluator rewrite.

strategy.description: Header markers first, documented fallback heuristic second.

fallback.description: The documented fallback heuristic used when no header marker matches; versioned with this file (review R5).

id.description: Stable criterion ID, e.g. S-01. Referenced by generated tests, repair justifications, and criteria-ref commit markers (review R2).

section.description: The SOAP section this criterion applies to, or null for run-wide criteria such as the Structure rules of spec section 8.2.

source.description: Where the criterion came from (spec section 9, Criterion.source).

note.description: Required when source is 'assumption': the assumption recorded explicitly (spec section 7.1 rules). Enforced by tools/validate.py.
